dedupe_keys.name: indoor occupancy ground truth dataset with variable ventilation

description: An Aalto University team publishes three CSV tables from a controlled office-room experiment in Finland. Zenodo lists the files under CC BY 4.0. The test room held up to four people and used variable-air-volume ventilation. Recorded channels include occupant count, airflow, carbon dioxide, temperature, humidity and pressure, with supply and exhaust settings described on the page. These paired signals can calibrate occupancy detection and demand-controlled ventilation in building-operation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. Coverage is a laboratory room designed to resemble an office, not an occupied commercial building over a full year. A limitation is that the small number of occupants and controlled activity may not represent changing schedules, open windows or real building controls. Sensor specifications are provided, but measured accuracy under every test condition remains unverified. No CSV was downloaded or ventilation balance recalculated.
